texts.zh:
母星上生产的资源只够我们走到这一步，好在我们的£science_ship£科研船在另外一颗星球上发现了一处资源矿藏！

是时候派£construction_ship£工程船[GetBuildGrow]一座£mining_station£开采站了。

开采站可以在帝国境内建造，它能自动采集所环绕天体上的£minerals£矿物、£energy£能量币以及£strategic_resource£战略资源。

选择工程船；

£dot_green£右键点击一个境内£system£恒星系
£dot_green£选择[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站

开采站需要花费能量币作为维护费。
texts.en:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Luckily our £science_ship£ Science Ship has just found a resource deposit on another world!

The time has come to use our £construction_ship£ Construction Ship to [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ Mining Station.

Mining Stations can be built within our borders and automatically collect £minerals£ Minerals, £energy£ Energy Credits, and £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources.

With the Construction Ship selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a claimed £system£ System
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Stations

Mining Stations have an Energy Credit upkeep cost.
